newsitem.title: UK: BA jet evacuated after engine fire in Puerto Rico.
newsitem.headline: BA jet evacuated after engine fire in Puerto Rico.

text.p: All 263 passengers and crew on board a British Airways Plc DC-10 jet were evacuated after an engine caught fire just before take-off from Puerto Rico, a company spokesman said on Monday.
Two of the 249 passengers needed hospital treatment after being hurt in Sunday's evacuation at San Juan airport. None of the 14 crew was injured.
The BA spokesman, speaking by telephone, said an investigation had started into why one of the plane's three engines caught fire. Airport fire crews quickly extinguished the blaze.
A replacement plane carrying the passengers was due to land at London's Gatwick airport at 6.30 a.m. (0530 GMT) on Tuesday.
